summary: Added missing Task JSON Schema and hardened schema validation to catch unresolved local $ref targets with python/python3 compatibility.
Added a negative schema fixture for broken local $ref targets and wired a deterministic self-check into schema validation.
Added a valid Task fixture and deterministic schema validation for it, restoring task schema coverage in this worktree.

Added a deterministic schema lint wrapper script and restored missing Task schema so schema linting runs from one command with stable checks.

Added a pre-commit schema JSON parse checker with deterministic smoke coverage for invalid JSON rejection.
Documented a step-by-step schema validation workflow in README and added a deterministic check to keep documented commands aligned with executable scripts.
Switched CI schema validation to the repo-local lint wrapper and added a deterministic check to keep the CI hook pinned to scripts/lint-schemas.sh.
Added a lightweight schema edit changelog format and a deterministic validator, then wired README workflow checks to prevent format drift.
Added deterministic README/schema index coverage validation so docs stay aligned with schemas/v1/schema.json oneOf refs.
Added a ready-for-review gate checklist artifact plus a deterministic validator script to keep gate expectations explicit and testable.
Added deterministic self-host artifact validation to catch malformed milestone/report/update/log files and inconsistent milestone counts before handoff.
Hardened self-host artifact validation by enforcing contiguous milestone IDs and requiring report milestone_completed to reference a done milestone.
Added deterministic cross-checks so the latest implementation log entry must align with report milestone and reported file lists.
Hardened self-host artifact reliability by enforcing UTC ISO-8601 timestamp format checks and adding deterministic regression coverage.
Hardened self-host artifact validation by enforcing allowed status values and report/update status alignment, with deterministic regression coverage.
Hardened self-host artifact validation by enforcing deterministic key order for the latest implementation log entry, with a dedicated regression script.
Hardened self-host artifact reliability by enforcing contiguous done milestone progression and adding deterministic regression coverage.
Hardened self-host artifact validation by requiring report milestone_completed to track the latest done milestone, with deterministic regression coverage.
Hardened self-host artifact validation by enforcing non-empty scalar text fields in report/update artifacts, with deterministic regression coverage.
